description: Reinstall the operating system on a dedicated server. DESTRUCTIVE AND NOT REVERSIBLE: the disks are wiped — every site, database, mail store, key and config on that machine is gone, and there is no snapshot to go back to the way a VPS has. Make sure the customer has what they need off the box first. Pick os_id with `impreza_api_call` on /dedicated/{serviceId}/os-images.
name: impreza_dedicated_reinstall
